@graph.name: Product Roadmap
@graph.description: Elenchon's development plan following deployment: September go-live, months 1-5 of refinement in real use, and a major feature delivery at month 6.

itemListElement.name: Deployment & Rollout (September)
itemListElement.description: On-site installation and configuration of the local server, with role-based training and the first WPS records, qualifications, work types and project structures entered alongside your team.

itemListElement.name: Refinement in Real Use (Months 1-5)
itemListElement.description: Continuous UI and workflow refinement, feature tuning in response to real use, and new document templates and export formats on request.

itemListElement.name: Granular NDT Tracking (Month 6, Standard tier)
itemListElement.description: Deep, integrated Non-Destructive Testing tracking delivered natively to Standard users — test requests, results, and their link to the specific joint and repair cycle.

itemListElement.name: PWHT Cycle Tracking (Month 6, Standard tier)
itemListElement.description: Post-weld heat treatment tracked by total number of cycles and total cycle time, tied to the joints it applies to.

itemListElement.name: Productivity Manager (Month 6, Premium tier)
itemListElement.description: Throughput per worker, work type and project stage, time spent per operation, and historical trends.

itemListElement.name: Visual Production Tracker (Month 6, Premium tier)
itemListElement.description: A live, visual read on the state of production across the whole project, surfacing bottlenecks while there is still time to act.
